message: てるてるアゼル

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Azel.」

name: Synn
message: 「Now that you've gotten used to academy life, why don't you try joining a club or something?」

name: Azel
message: 「No need.」

name: Synn
message: 「You came all this way to study abroad, after all. I think you should try enjoying yourself a bit more.」

name: Azel
message: 「You're persistent.」

name: Synn
message: 「...Could it be that you've already joined one, or something?」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Hey, wait a second! ...He left.」

name: Paqy
message: 「I bet it's one of those. A club he's too embarrassed to tell people about. Short for embarrass--」

name: Paqy
message: 「--brella!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. President! It's an emergency!」

name: Synn
message: 「L-Lolotte... What's wrong all of a sudden?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「A Demon has appeared!!」

name: Synn
message: 「What?! Got it. Let's go!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. President, look over there!」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte, let's do a pincer attack.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Understood!」

name: Synn
message: 「A―Alright, now's our chance while it hasn't noticed―sneak attack!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. President!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? W-Whaaa!」
The Demon's body slam hits me head-on, sending my body flying into the air.
I'm blown all the way back to the fountain in an instant.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. President! Are you alright?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah, somehow...」

name: Synn
message: 「――!! It's coming this way!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. President! Please watch out!」

name: Synn
message: 「Gah, this time for sure!」

name: Synn
message: 「――Wait, whoa!」
My foot slipped, and just like that, I――

name: Synn
message: 「Ow!」
I headbutted the Demon and passed out.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. President. Are you alive?」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah…… barely…… wait, I'm all sticky……」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, what about the Demon!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Out cold in a flash from your headbutt, Mr. President」

name: Synn
message: 「I see. Well, that's a relief」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Now that our job is safely done, I think you should do something about that soaking-wet state of yours first」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. Good point. Lolotte, you don't have to hold back--you can plug your nose, you know」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The old butler lent me some nose plugs earlier」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, right」

name: Synn
message: 「Sigh, still, this stench is awful……」

name: Paqy
message: 「Man, you're such a klutz, Demon Lord」

name: Synn
message: 「I hate to admit it, but isn't keeping your distance like that a bit much? Even though you're usually clinging to me nonstop」

name: Paqy
message: 「My awesome fluffy body's gonna get all damp, ain't it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Must be nice living the high life, honestly」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, I am the Great Sage, after all」
Still, even though it wasn't late yet, there weren't any other students in sight.

name: Synn
message: 「I wonder if the swim club has the day off today」

name: Paqy
message: 「Beats me」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, at least I didn't get in everyone's way.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yeah, people'd look at ya funny.」

name: Synn
message: 「You're acting like it's none of your business!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ooh, scary. Hurry up and go wash yourself off already!」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm going, even without you telling me.」
Seen off by Paqy, I headed into the boys' locker room.
I was tugging at my uniform clinging to my wet body, so I couldn't see well in front of me when I opened the door.
And then, heading straight for the shower room, I poked my head out from where I'd undressed--
I couldn't believe my eyes.
After entering the boys' locker room, shirtless from the waist up, I was supposed to have made a beeline for the showers.
However, standing frozen there was a familiar girl in an unfamiliar state.

name: Azel
message: 「W-Why are you...」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well, it's not so much 'why' as, how do I put it...」

name: Azel
message: （I should have put up a barrier, so how...）

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, no! Azel! This is the boys' locker room!」

name: Azel
message: 「A-As if I would know that!」

name: Synn
message: 「It's a good thing it was me who walked in, though...」

name: Azel
message: 「...L-Looking like that... what are you talking about!」

name: Synn
message: 「Gah, I'm half-naked! That really is dangerous!」
Meanwhile, Azel stood frozen in front of me, wrapped only in a bath towel.
She must have just finished swimming in the pool.
Water droplets dripped onto the floor, and a school-issued swimsuit lay carelessly...

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? If her swimsuit is lying right here, that means...」
Underneath that bath towel, could she be--

name: Azel
message: 「S-Stop that! Where are you looking!」
Noticing my gaze, Azel pulled her shoulders in tightly.
Not that I could see anything with it all covered up, yet right behind that single layer of cloth was unmistakably Azel's...

name: Azel
message: 「G-Get out, quickly! O-Otherwise--」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No, Azel! If you go rampaging around dressed like that!」

name: Azel
message: 「Shut up! Right now, killing you is my top priority!」

name: Synn
message: 「If you accidentally trip or something, uh, your hem might flip up and things'll get really bad!」

name: Azel
message: 「As if someone like me would ever trip--」

name: Azel
message: 「Ah」

name: Azel
message: 「Diiie!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ugyaaah!」

name: Paqy
message: 「D-Demon Lord... You were supposed to go wash yourself, so why are you in an even worse state than before...?」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No, it's nothing, nothing at all...」
Sigh. Why do I have to go through this...

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, Azel!」

name: Azel
message: 「Shut up, don't talk」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel... you joined the swim club. You could've told me if you did」

name: Azel
message: 「No, I didn't!」

name: Synn
message: 「Then why isn't anyone else here」

name: Azel
message: 「I... I just booked it for private use」

name: Synn
message: 「I knew it, Azel... you're no ordinary person. The only one who could pull off booking a place for private use like this is--」

name: Paqy
message: 「Gulp...」

name: Synn
message: 「You must be a princess of the Principality of Sharo-Ma!」

name: Azel
message: 「I-If that's what you want to think, then think whatever you like」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yes, my lord. As you command!」
When I checked with Helena later, she flatly denied it with a bright smile.
